note: A ring with three positions and only two distinct ones (SPEC 3.7). The count that decides is of DISTINCT positions, by longitude and latitude, so a reader that counts array entries reads three and keeps an area with no inside. The area is dropped whole: this format has no holes or inner rings, so the area is the smallest unit that can go. The second area has exactly three distinct positions, the least a ring may hold, and survives, which pins the boundary from the other side.
